Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s instructions to search for both films. From its first action onward, it only queried “Lo Zappatore” and repeatedly reran similar searches, ignoring the required queries for “Placer Sangriento” (and its potential alternates) despite multiple subsequent Planner reminders. This omission prevented collecting the second film’s release year, making it impossible to determine which film was released more recently and directly leading to the wrong/unfinished solution.
